additional_info.subject: RE: ID0378303-DC/Si-D/AU-[MP / P9 170000946] Door Adjustment CRM:00579001073
additional_info.body:
Hello Vaishnavi,
Answer to the below:
door is closing properly or not/ or there is any misalignment?
Please see photos attached of door alignment. This is with the washer added to the door itself, however without the washers the door switch would not register as closed. This was why in ticket
ID0334079 we requested the instructions on how to adjust the door.
whether there is any problem with the door switch itself?
If you press the door switch in, it registers being pressed.
The bracket the door switch is mounted on is not deformed or does it allow adjustment.
as you mentioned, door switch is not triggering, whether it is due to misalignment of door or switch itself is faulty? we need to check.
When pressing on the door switch it registers correctly, however when closing the door, it does not completely register to door being closed.
As you are aware that there are 2 limit switches (on front door and back door). So need to check, it occurred due to which limit switch?
This is only an issue when you open the front door.
Have you checked manually pressing the switch, whether the alarm is disappearing? Did you perform 24V healthiness for the switch, the signal from switch to PLC?
Yes, this has been checked and the switch registers being pushed.
In previous ticket ID0334079, it was mentioned the circuit breaker error. Is there any active error regarding circuit breaker?
No, this error is not active. This is the error the CPO received via the VendorError code in response to the door being open. (first the door alarm and then because the main MCCB opens, they received this error via OCPP).
For the additional washer added, could you please confirm where it was added (Please share the image for the better clarification) -
Photo Added.
Our question is, how is the door alignment process intended to be carried out, when installed in the field, as the charger is completely assembled and thus allow ease of access to the required alignment points. Please review these instructions with product care and help us understand if the only way this can be adjusted is with the dismantling of the metal sheets on the automation panel.
Is it also possible that if the installation surface is not completely flat, the charger base could be deformed, which could affect the door alignment?
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
